branch: __title -> the header's rename control, and the bridge payload it emits
provenance: The `__title` frame is OURS (ChatPanel.pushTitle), so its shape is a fact about our own code. The RECORD the rename eventually writes is the CLI's, read verbatim from the 2.1.226 binary — `{type:"custom-title", customTitle: title.trim(), sessionId}` appended with O_APPEND — and that half is pinned by SessionStoreRenameTest, not here. This fixture covers only what the webview owes: the control appears when there is a name, hides when there is not, seeds the editor, cancels without emitting, and emits exactly one well-formed message when it saves. window.__bridge is swapped for a recorder around the submit steps and restored afterwards, so asserting the payload does NOT actually rename the sandbox's session.

steps.note: a named conversation offers the pencil; the name goes in .t-txt so the control survives it

expect.why: the title text lives in its own span
setTitle must not eat the pencil — writing textContent on the wrapper would
there is a transcript to append to, so the control is offered

steps.note: NEGATIVE CONTROL — an unnamed thread has no transcript yet, so no rename is offered

expect.why: empty title means no session on disk
hidden rather than offering a click that could only fail
and clicking it anyway opens nothing

steps.note: the pencil turns the header into an editor seeded with the current name

expect.why: the header becomes the editor in place
clicking the NAME opens it too — the pencil is the hint, not the only way in
seeded with the current name, so a small correction is a small edit
the static title and the editor never show at once

steps.note: Escape cancels and keeps the original name — a half-typed rename is never kept

expect.js: (() => { const i = document.getElementById('convInput'); i.value = 'half typed'; i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:'Escape', bubbles:true})); return document.getElementById('head').classList.contains('editing'); })()
expect.why: editor closed
and the name is untouched

steps.note: saving emits exactly one rename message carrying the trimmed name and no id — Kotlin owns which session that is

expect.js: (() => { const real = window.__bridge; const sent = []; window.__bridge = function (j) { sent.push(j); }; try { document.querySelector('#convTitle .t-edit').click(); const i = document.getElementById('convInput'); i.value = '  Queue spacing fix  '; i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:'Enter', bubbles:true})); } finally { window.__bridge = real; } return JSON.stringify(sent.map(JSON.parse)); })()
expect.why: one message, trimmed title, no id
and the editor closes on save

steps.note: NEGATIVE CONTROL — a blank name is a no-op, not an erase: nothing is sent

expect.js: (() => { const real = window.__bridge; const sent = []; window.__bridge = function (j) { sent.push(j); }; try { document.querySelector('#convTitle .t-edit').click(); const i = document.getElementById('convInput'); i.value = '   '; i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:'Enter', bubbles:true})); } finally { window.__bridge = real; } return sent.length; })()
expect.why: there is no record that un-names a conversation, and the CLI refuses an empty title too
the name stands

steps.note: an unasked-for sessions frame re-renders the list WITHOUT opening it — Kotlin re-pushes after a rename, and that must not pop the panel open

expect.why: nobody asked for the panel, so it stays shut
but the rows are refreshed, so opening it later shows the new name

steps.note: the history BUTTON still opens it — the flag must not break the path it protects

expect.js: (() => { const real = window.__bridge; window.__bridge = function () {}; try { document.getElementById('histBtn').click(); } finally { window.__bridge = real; } window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({type:'sessions', items:[{id:'s1', title:'Queue spacing fix', time:0, size:1024, tokens:10}]})); return document.getElementById('histPanel').classList.contains('show'); })()
expect.why: asked for, so it opens

expect.js: (() => { document.getElementById('histPanel').classList.remove('show'); window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({type:'sessions', items:[{id:'s1', title:'x', time:0, size:1, tokens:1}]})); return document.getElementById('histPanel').classList.contains('show'); })()
expect.why: and the flag is spent — the NEXT unasked frame does not reopen it

steps.note: NEGATIVE CONTROL — re-saving the SAME name sends nothing either

expect.js: (() => { const real = window.__bridge; const sent = []; window.__bridge = function (j) { sent.push(j); }; try { document.querySelector('#convTitle .t-edit').click(); document.getElementById('convInput').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', {key:'Enter', bubbles:true})); } finally { window.__bridge = real; } return sent.length; })()
expect.why: an unchanged name is not a rename — no record, no re-push
